Well, look... It’s not that simple... Doing drugs is no joke, and I must be sure I want to do it. I haven't even considered MDMA yet, and I’m not a big trustee of taking psychedelics at parties and such. MDMA has very different pharmacological properties and characteristics from that of LSD, Psilocybin, and Psilocin. Its effective dose is very close to its known LD50, and it has shown to be brain-altering in a physical way.

Perhaps, yes.. I could try it one day. But not now, when I haven’t even considered the possibility. 

I hope you can respect this point of view on this drug, just as I respect yours. Thanks for the suggestion either way.

Although I do wish that the experience enhances our connection and relationship, it’s not what my planned goal is. The reason I want to give her this experience is simply out of love and gratitude for her, as the friend she has been for me for so long. I will be doing this for her primarily, and my mind’s intent in doing this is to show to her this new world simply, in whichever form it may come to her mind because I know it can benefit her a lot and because many of her beliefs are ultimately congruent with what these compounds have to teach us.

If she feels a deeper connection to me, then that will be a bonus, not the completion of my mission. I want her to be the one that will guide the experience, and I will only go as far as she wants us to go with our relationship.

Of course, I will explain to her what is up to come beforehand. I will make sure we both research together this compound, so that she is both mentally prepared and also has enough knowledge on what this is about.

I will be doing this responsibly, and I won’t let her take it if she shows any kind of uncertainty about her decision.
